id: title:dmarticus:move the evidence rail toggle to the page toolbar

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the collapsed state behavior and button implementation of the sidebar rail toggle, potentially affecting the user's ability to expand or collapse the navigation rail.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a localized frontend change: removing the CSS and conditional rendering for a collapsed aside state while retaining the expanded state, and refactoring the toggle button implementation. This is a bounded, substantive change to the UI behavior.
review.uncertainty: This chunk alone does not establish broader systemic risk reduction or wider adoption; the tier is assigned based on the visible, bounded implementation and its relevance to the navigation rail, not on unverified outcomes or PR metadata.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file frontend change.
